say:3:1522218001:0.text: How dare you spy on Halia's secrets?!
say:3:1522218001:0.source_cn: 无耻之徒，你们竟敢偷听呼临城的机密！

say:4:1522218002:0.text: Skimming food off the poor and calling it military logistics... not exactly a proud secret.
say:4:1522218002:0.source_cn: 抢赈灾粮充当军粮，确实是很不光彩的秘密。

say:5:1522218003:0.text: Lieutenant Lygos. Taking rations from starving civilians, even for war, is beneath you.
say:5:1522218003:0.source_cn: 隆尔副将，为了战争而与徘徊在生死边缘的饥饿百姓抢夺赈灾...

say:6:1522218004:1.text: What do a bunch of bookish mages know?
say:6:1522218004:1.source_cn: 哼，几个见识浅薄的魔法师懂什么。

say:7:1522218005:0.text: Halia's not your concern. I owe you no explanation.
say:7:1522218005:0.source_cn: 呼临城的一切都与你们无关，我没必要向你们解释。

choice_prompt:8:1522218005.text: Halia's not your concern. I owe you no explanation.
choice_prompt:8:1522218005.source_cn: 呼临城的一切都与你们无关，我没必要向你们解释。

say:10:1522218008:0.text: He's no fool. He knows what goes on in Halia better than you outsiders ever will.
say:10:1522218008:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯又不是傻子，呼临城内的局势他比你们这些外人更清楚。

say:11:1522218009:1.text: Most of the council wants this war. Even the Regulus bows to the pressure. If Perseus weren't so hesitant, the full assault would've happened ages ago!
say:11:1522218009:1.source_cn: 大半的议事官都主战，连领主也只能顺从。要不是珀尔修斯一...

say:12:1522218010:1.text: The fact that none of this mess has been addressed publicly tells you one thing: he doesn't want to risk hurting troop morale.
say:12:1522218010:1.source_cn: 这些乱七八糟的事没有抬到台面上来处理，就说明他也不希望...

say:14:1522218011:1.text:
Understand what I'm saying?
Especially you, beast.
say:14:1522218011:1.source_cn: 懂我的意思吗？\n——尤其是你，那个野兽。

say:15:1522218012:0.text: <style="highlight">The final assault on the Wildborn is almost here</style>. And no one's stopping it.

say:16:1522218013:0.text: I'm not a beast. And Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> would never let you win.
say:16:1522218013:0.male: I'm not a beast. And Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> would never let you win.
say:16:1522218013:0.female: I'm not a beast. And Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> would never let you win.

say:17:1522218014:0.text: We'll see. We'll see who stands in the end.
say:17:1522218014:0.source_cn: 那就走着瞧吧。看看胜利会属于谁。

say:21:1522218017:0.text: Perseus isn't ready to launch a full war yet. There's still time.
say:21:1522218017:0.source_cn: 现在珀尔修斯还不愿大动干戈，战争尚有转圜的余地。

say:22:1522218018:0.text: If the Regulus of Halia agrees to meet us, we'll do all we can to stop this before it begins.
say:22:1522218018:0.source_cn: 只要呼临城的领主愿意接见我们，我们一定会竭尽全力劝说他...

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 我们会把这件事告诉珀尔修斯

say:24:1522218007:0.text: Don't need your help. Go cry to Perseus!
say:24:1522218007:0.source_cn: 不需要，你大可直接告诉珀尔修斯！
say:24:1522218007:0.male: Don't need your help. Go cry to Perseus!
say:24:1522218007:0.female: Don't need your help. Go cry to Perseus!

choice:8:1:2.text: What if I could keep your secret?
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 要是我说可以帮你保密呢？
choice:8:1:2.male: What if I could keep your secret?
choice:8:1:2.female: What if I could keep your secret?
